cueSelection.rule: Greedy first three distinct normalized words in ascending ID order with pairwise-disjoint codes.

artifact.name: NeuroSphere formation
artifact.reset: Rest membrane, zero fast adaptation/activity, empty queues, input schedules start from adapters. Age and threshold retain their locked values.

referenceIdentity.scope: Exact UTF-8 serialization of cores, ordered formed edges and weights, full locked native export, A/B responses and jitter schedule; training field remains unlocked.

phase.wiring: Dense ordinary native Synapse projections at0.02; preserved pool radius60 and native geometric delays; no fixed flags.
phase.teacher: Native env.forcedSpike only; natural output activity retained, refractoriness respected, no output clamp.
phase.inputAdapter: Existing feature ports retained; add O_A/O_B output channels, start readout IO counters at the phase boundary.
phase.jitter: Dedicated seeded stream, one U{0..15} draw per cue bit; shared across matched controls.

codebook: Host vocabulary.get(conceptId).word lookup for the firing output cell; not generated language.
